horizon.bestDepth: D4 first run -> D33 (Mirror King wall); last 8h absence produced no new record

sameDayRetelling: Quill Ash went down right after I spent 18 Legacy on Clear Lungs because gas had killed the two heirs before him, and he walked through the Bloat Mother, the Lich and the Foundry Master to a new best of D23 and then D28. At D28 the Lurker Queen's summoned lurkers surrounded him ('foes on every side'), my retreat rule had no path, and he died at 1 hp with $20589 already secured. The death screen offered 'foe: boss -> read silence', I took it, and later had to narrow it to depth >= 28 myself after it wasted a scroll on the Bloat Mother.

humanProbes.clarity: Mostly yes: the forecast shows 'D9 fens → D13 · behind warlord <13%' and jumps to 88% after an upgrade ('UPGRADED · D9 +88'), but I could not tell why the death gem said 'risky' and then 'measuring', and a fix it applied dropped D22 to '<13%'.
humanProbes.decisions: I wrote 'foe: gas · adjacent ≥ 1 → retreat', saw 'death 13→88%', and rewrote it as 'foes ≥ 2 · hp < 30% → retreat'; yes, I would make that change again.
humanProbes.mastery: An hour ago I didn't scope rules; now I know 'foe: boss → read silence' needs 'depth ≥ 28' after watching 'BLOAT MOTHER | SILENCE | read silence' burn the scroll.
humanProbes.tension: I sweated at 'BLOAT MOTHER DOWN ... 6/24 hp starving −9', and the game noticed: the next floor read 'Carried $751 · Secured $751'.
humanProbes.feel: Speed modes respond at once ('fights only 2×', '16×' in corridors), but the second normal-speed watch had about 170 s where the log only toggled '4×' / '1×'.
humanProbes.surprise: 'max hp 44→22 · recovery −22' from hunger and 'max hp 46→5 · drain −41' changed how I read every later death; the warlord at D8 repeated on every run.
humanProbes.expression: A fighter who heals first, backs off telegraphs under 40%, reads silence only past D28 and swings at mirrors — 'Guarded reader' with 5/5 rules.
humanProbes.story: Orin Ash drank the oily potion at 6/22 hp because of my rule: 'The oily one: poison · Gambled: poison potion'.
humanProbes.pacing: A run takes 45 s to 4 min with D1–7 folded into one line ('D1–7 · 100% · +$239'); the 8h absence came back with only '5 RUNS · 3 died' and no new record.
humanProbes.failure: 'own poison · D13 · hero at 2 hp · RULE · drink unknown at 50% backfired' with 'fixes · 12 replays of D13 ... survives 12/12 · was 0/12' — my fault, and I could see it.
humanProbes.social: Heirs carry the bloodline and 'avenged Grusk' / 'grudge: Ulog the lurker' lines, but no relationship developed.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose to try hand control at D13 ('Hand control · awaits order') and to buy a fifth rule slot that nothing asked for.
humanProbes.progression: Within-run: 'Carried $20589 · Secured'; persistent: forge, Legacy ranks, tactics; automation: scout ('sends him each rest'), porter, apprentice ('+2 steps · mail +2 · pack 7').
humanProbes.aesthetic: The town at night with a lit campfire and a torch-lit cave mouth is a place I'd sit in; the dungeon view is small under a dense text log (audio unassessed).
humanProbes.return: After 4h I came back to 'Boss defeated · Lurker Queen · ▶ watch kill', a 'Pick one' (drill / legacy / forge plate −30%) and a Mirror King death to fix; I decided on Mirror rhythm and moving heal above retreat.
humanProbes.attribution: The last run ended with a 'mirror shade · D27' death; partly my decision — I had swapped in mirror read and the report said 'picked 32% · taught 2% · chores 65%'.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Forecast per floor + boss + counter ('· king ... counter: Mirror rhythm') and deltas ('VS LAST RUN · D14 +38') make goals and consequences readable. Lapses: unexplained gem states 'risky'/'measuring'/'WRITE'; a fix applied from 'risky' collapsed D22 to <13%; fix 5 said 'survives 9/12' and also 'death 29→90%'; first death suggested 'BUY pack 4' with no reason; the WRITE fix's verb 'tactic reflect read' was not offered in the pen.

Real trade-offs in rule edits with forecast feedback ('death 13→88%' for gas retreat; telegraph retreat at hp<40% vs always). But many choices were dominated: stance compare said 'Guarded better 8/8'; forge buys were cheapest-first; most edits were accepting the top death-screen fix.

Visible learning: rule scoping (depth ≥ 28), ordering (ORDER death: 'drink heal at 45% under retreat vs telegraph'), learning hunger/drain shrink max HP. Best D4 → D33. Plateau at the Mirror King over the 8h absence; legacy 146 piled up behind 'Reach D18'/gated ranks with nothing I could buy.

Carried vs Secured is a stake I watched ('Carried $1141 · Secured $898 · Heading home' then died, '$243 lost'); Bloat Mother killed at 6/24 hp. But watched fights can't be changed (hand control did nothing useful), and offline deaths just read 'lost $12795'.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Smooth on GPU, instant speed switching, callouts ('POPS!', 'REFLECTED!', 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN'). Lapse: ~170 s dead stretch at normal speed in watch 2 (only 4×/1× toggles in the log); hand control 'descend' gave no visible response. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Distinct situations that changed my config: own poison, gas, hunger/drain max-HP loss, summoned-lurker surround, mirror shade paralysis, Master 'REPELLED needs a counter'. Repetition: D8 warlord / D13 mother / D18 lich every run, D1–12 identical in shape.
5-row rule set plus 2 tactics and personality traits read as mine ('Guarded reader'), but most rows were death-screen suggestions I accepted rather than authored.

Runs have turns (own-poison gamble; Quill's D28 surround; heirs' bones found: 'Found heir 1's bones: 12 items'; grudges avenged). The chronicle is mostly a log; the anecdotes came from the death screens.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-play: runs are short and folded ('D1–7 · 100%'); fights-only is brisk. Admin: check-ins are bounded (report → Pick one → town → send). Cadence: 20m/4h/8h feel different but 8h gave fewer runs than expected and no record. Normal-speed dead stretch noted under feel.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Best part of the game: cause + hp margin + the rule that fired or failed per tick ('retreat at 50% · no path · ← foes on every side') + 12-replay fixes with survives x/12. Recovery is instant. Lapse: fix stats sometimes contradict themselves and one applied fix ('risky') made the forecast collapse with no warning I could read.
I set my own goals (beat the King, buy a rule slot), chose route-level tactics, tried hand control. Goal chain itself is linear (next boss).

All three layers observed: within-run carry/secure; persistent forge/Legacy/tactics/rule slots/classes of potions; automation every few minutes early (scout, porter, apprentice, keeper; 'Workers started · apprentice +2 steps'). Lapse: the 8h absence produced no new record and Legacy 146 sat unspendable behind gates.
Pixel-art town at night and the banner death screen are atmospheric; the dungeon view is cramped under a large text log and HUD. Audio unassessed.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: Every return had something to read and decide ('Pick one', boss kill to watch, a death with fixes, 'REPELLED · needs a counter · WRITE'). But payoff did not scale predictably: 20m '1 died · $0 · lost $1646', 4h '4 died · D33 · $21020', 8h '5 runs · 3 died · no record · lost $12795'.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Deaths are tagged RULE / ORDER and name my rows ('drink unknown at 50% backfired'); reports split 'picked 32% · taught 2% · chores 65%'. Lapse: two-thirds of play is 'chores' I don't own, and several deaths (hunger, drain, paralysis) traced to nothing I wrote.
